issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'בֶּן אַמְצִי' (son of Amtsi), but the Chinese renders it as '暗色伊人的兒子' (son of the Amsei people), which appears to be a mistranslation of the proper name 'Amtsi' as an ethnic/gentilic term rather than a personal name. The name should be transliterated as a personal name, e.g., '暗茨的兒子'.
